manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp225,476-478 defines ItemTransfer OUT by STTID=<OUTSIDE>, scheduled TFTIME, available-item or split transfer, nominal and on-hand changes when actually performed, and TFDT ignored for OUT. pp681-683 and 717 define tracked item-position STSZ/STOHA. Installed dictionary gives ItemTransfer seven-column schema.
controlled_design: Accepted I02.var01 IN parent retains its h4 one-unit IN to DEPOT-01, Item.TRACK=Y, ITEM half-hour collection, seed1, E04 FAST support structure and 36h horizon. Child appends one ItemTransfer row DEPOT-01 to <OUTSIDE> at h6, TFQTY1, TFDT0, and changes description. All 30 other tables are unchanged. h4 IN creates stock2 so h6 OUT has stock available. This is a positive OUT in an IN-then-OUT sequence, not a standalone OUT-only experiment.

pre_run_hypotheses.out: Native should create one OUT task at h6, remove one physical LRU from DEPOT-01, and tracked depot ItemResults STSZ/STOHA should change 2 to1 at h6 after the accepted h4 IN 1 to2. Exact removed item ID is conditional.
pre_run_hypotheses.later_demand: The later ordinary failure may consume the remaining depot spare and may alter service/repair timing; item identities, backorders, mission outcomes, report averages and terminal stock are conditional and must be reconciled from raw native evidence.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, delayed/split OUT despite available stock, absent item table, nominal/on-hand mismatch, duplicate transfer or source/closure mismatch is diagnostic; no positive OUT claim published.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run static audit of accepted IN parent, manual/dictionary pins, frozen child source and exact two-table delta
Session-0 SSH native run under host-wide mutex preserving GUI PID13340
Exact authored-table roundtrip, zero conversion errors, valid SXO/report and sealed raw files
Physical IN and OUT event/identity ledger, direct depot STSZ/STOHA interval changes at h4/h6, later demand and terminal stock reconciled
Author replay, independent read-only replay and final staged audit before publication
limits: Positive result would cover one zero-delay OUT of one LRU from one depot after a preceding accepted IN, with one seed. It would not establish independent OUT-only behavior, unavailable-stock split/backorder, BETWEEN, nonzero delay, priority, reorder or procurement.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
